approved_candidates.title: Parallel Execution of qualification_agent and job_criteria_agent
approved_candidates.observed_problem: Agents 'qualification_agent' (3.41s) and 'job_criteria_agent' (2.82s) are currently executed sequentially (total: 6.23s), despite having completely independent processing scopes and no mutual data dependencies.

supporting_evidence.dependency_verification: Verified independent: No direct/transitive edge between qualification_agent and job_criteria_agent, and no shared I/O coupling.

approved_candidates.proposed_solution: Execute 'qualification_agent' and 'job_criteria_agent' concurrently using an asynchronous scatter-gather branch. Join their outputs prior to downstream synthesis.

expected_benefit.critical_path_impact: Cuts 2.82s directly from sequential critical path.
expected_benefit.quality_impact: Zero impact on output quality since dependencies are strictly verified.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Immediate latency win with concurrency.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: No additional token cost (concurrent execution uses separate Groq keys).
tradeoffs_and_risks.output_quality_risk: None (data dependencies rigorously verified).

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Requires shadow validation against baseline traces to confirm behavioral equivalence.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Substantial speedup on first-stage document intake.
